Officer's narrative
On arrival at an intersection in Katy, Texas, I found a side impact between two vehicles. Driver 1 said they were
proceeding through the intersection when Driver 2 entered from the cross street and struck the driver's side. Driver 2
stated that Driver 1's vehicle, ahead of them, braked hard with no apparent reason. Driver 1 reported a shoulder
injury, which is consistent with the forces of a crash of this type, and was transported for evaluation. The Passenger
could not clearly say where they had been seated at the moment of impact. Both drivers and the Passenger said they
knew one another before the collision. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle is on a different side and at a different height
than the impact described by both parties. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known. Driver 1 is named on the policy
covering the vehicle. Further review of the vehicle damage and the statements of all parties is recommended.
</page>
